text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, when I went to visit a shrine...

text_block_list.name: Shinto Priest
text_block_list.text:
Dear Umamusume... Please, I beg of you... 
take care of the rest...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: "Priest! Pull yourself together, priest!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With the head priest collapsing, the 
shrine was temporarily entrusted to her. 
Having no other choice, Tamamo Cross...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Me, filling in for the shrine priest, huh? 
Well, can't be helped. Let's do this!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"Old man priest, hurry on back. Until 
then, guess I'll just casually deal with 
the shrine visitors..."

text_block_list.name: Female Student
text_block_list.text:
Kyaaah, an Umamusume Shinto priest...! So 
cuuute~!!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoa, hold up! Quit making such a 
racket! Pray properly, will ya?!

text_block_list.name: Female Student
text_block_list.text:
You called me out on it~! That makes you 
even cuter~!!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Wh-Why are you so happy about that...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The straight-man Umamusume priest. Her 
existence quickly became the talk of the 
town...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Wanna make a wish for now~? Umm, my wish 
is...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I hope it turns out nice and good♪

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
How am I supposed to grant that?! What do 
you even mean by "good vibes"?!

text_block_list.name: Shrine Visitors
text_block_list.text: (WAHAHAHAHA!)

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, thriving business is fine and all, 
but what's with all these onlookers? Is 
this some kinda Naniwa comedy sketch...?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I see. Well, if you're fine with it... 
let's keep going like this.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Alright! If any weirdos show up, I'm gonna 
call 'em out left and right!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
How lively it gets depends on the shrine 
visitors. As you wait, the Umamusume who 
arrives is—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"Yaeno-san, Ardan-san, over here! Let's go 
say a prayer!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Chiyono O, Yaeno Muteki, and Mejiro 
Ardan—the close trio of classmates—made 
their appearance.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Gods... please, as soon as possible...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Ah... I'm so dizzy... These stone steps 
are brutal...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Wait, pulling your punches at the last 
second?! Just go rest already!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"This silence... It seems perfect for 
practicing ancient martial arts."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: âBEGONE!!" hisses!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: "Don't give me that! Just pray, damn it!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
That's right, Yaeno-san. Visiting the 
shrine is important. I even have a proverb 
about it in my Chiyo-Notebook.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"Those who believe— are saved the moment 
they believe!"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I don't get it! Nothin' you're sayin' 
makes any sense!

text_block_list.name: Shrine Visitors
text_block_list.text: (WAHAHAHAHA!)

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Sheesh, what a bunch of clowns playing 
dumb...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Still, Trainer, you look awfully hyped up.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to the comic antics of the three 
girls, the straight-man Shinto priest 
gained an even greater reputation.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: ...Say something.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: ...Say something, dang it!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: "Wait, what!? Roger that☆"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Milady~! Miracle! Way-waaay☆ Vroom vroom 
vroooom!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Just blabberin' it out doesn't make it 
right! What are you all gettin' so hyped 
up for?!

text_block_list.name: Shrine Visitors
text_block_list.text: (Ahahaha...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The ones who arrived were the quiet bunch 
and the absurdly loud bunch. Even so, 
Tamamo Cross gave it her all playing the 
straight man and managed to get a decent 
amount of laughs.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Umamusume who excel on dirt, such as Hokko 
Tarumae, Copano Rickey, and Wonder Acute, 
have appeared.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Praying at the shrine... It might not do 
much good, but...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"May I give it my all for the sake of my 
hometown, Tomakomai."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"Man, this is tough to deal with... when 
she's this dead serious."

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Mhm, mhm, the red of the torii gate is in 
this position... Which means...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"Mr. Priest. Protection from natural 
disasters looks solid. It's great 
terrain♪"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Y-Yeah... thanks a bunch... Wait...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Gaaah, it's kinda hard to play the 
straight man here. Is dirt racing just 
built on a different vibe?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
There, there, good girl... Here, have a 
piece of candy.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Unable to deliver a proper retort, Tamamo 
Cross ended up being comforted instead. 
Her fiery enthusiasm had completely 
backfired...
